description: Ex-Aerolíneas Argentinas Boeing 737-200 LV-JTD (c/n 20523/285), moved by road from Ezeiza in July 2017 and installed as the theme park's 'airport' attraction with a boarding experience; showing weathering by April 2022.
BAe Jetstream 3201 LV-ZRL (c/n 928) displayed beside the Boeing 737 at the theme park's airport attraction, without propellers (April 2022).
